title: A W-Shaped Ga-Dy-Dy-Dy-Ga Cluster: Synthesis, Characterization, and Magnetic Properties

synthesis.procedure: A mixture of Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (45 mg, 0.1 mmol), Ga(NO3)3·6H2O (24.4 mg, 0.1 mmol), and H2L (48.6 mg, 0.2 mmol) was dissolved in MeOH (20 mL). After 10 min stirring, Et3N (70 μL, 0.5 mmol) was added under stirring. The final solution was stirred for 10 min and filtered. After two days, yellow block-shaped crystals of 1 suitable for X-ray crystallography were isolated. Manipulations (apart from ligand synthesis) were performed under aerobic conditions.
synthesis.time: 10 min stirring after mixing; 10 min after adding Et3N; crystals after two days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic solution reaction in methanol, filtration, and standing crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: solution filtered; yellow block-shaped crystals isolated after two days

properties.summary: Zero-field SMM behavior for the W-shaped Ga2Dy3 cluster. Room-temperature χT matches three isolated Dy(III) ions plus diamagnetic Ga(III). χT decreases on cooling, reaching 16.40 cm3 K mol−1 at 1.8 K, consistent with thermal depopulation/anisotropy and possible weak antiferromagnetic Dy···Dy exchange. Magnetization saturates near 16.10 μB at 2 K and 7 T. Frequency- and temperature-dependent ac susceptibility under zero dc field shows two relaxation regimes attributed to QTM/weak coupling at low T and single-ion Dy behavior at high T (Ueff ≈ 9.28 K and 55.47 K). Applied dc fields have little effect on the dynamics above 2 K.
